item.title: Chatham Skin Clinic addresses infection-control lapses; no infections
item.description: The Chatham Skin Clinic has taken steps to address an infection control lapse at its operation that recently prompted a community alert from Chatham-Kent Public Health. The health unit identified lapses in the sterilization and reprocessing of medical equipment at the clinic, located at 125 Keil Dr. S., from Oct. 1, 2024 to Jan. 30. […]

item.title: Local roundup: Ballhawks win silver; Bluebirds lose; Hawks, Lancers in hockey final
item.description: The Chatham 15U Ballhawks won silver medals at the Ontario Volleyball Association’s McGregor Cup 15U boys tournament Saturday in Thorold.

item.title: PHOTOS: Tilbury Bluebirds vs. Alvinston Killer Bees
item.description: The Alvinston Killer Bees and Tilbury Bluebirds are tied 1-1 in their Northern Premier Hockey League first-round playoff series after the Killer Bees' 7-2 win Tuesday.

item.title: Chatham woman charged after van and trailer rollover in Petrolia: OPP
item.description: A Chatham woman faces charges after a single-vehicle roller in Petrolia on Tuesday, said Lambton OPP.
